reviews.title: Loosing followers left right and centre
reviews.text: I’ve built up a huge following since going viral last year and was gaining followers so fast which meant I was literally getting thousands of views in the hour or so after uploading a video. Ever since the community guidelines were updated in September I’m losing followers every day. At this point I’ve lost over 3000 followers and while I know that is a minuscule percentage of my followers as I have 421.1k followers I am literally not able to gain followers. I look on the analytics on TikTok studio I tend to look at post views and followers and I do not seem to be able to sustain  high post views like I was until months ago. And when I say months ago I feel like this has been an on going problem for me form at least July I believe. I’m really disheartened at the moment because I put so much work into my content and it feels like I’m being punished. I seem to be getting a cycle repeating on me where I will get a pocket of about 4 to 10 videos that get over 10k views followed by a dip of another 4 to 10 videos that get stuck under 10k videos for days maybe weeks. The like ratios on videos now days really don’t make sense either because how can you have a video that gets over 60k views but only gets 1k likes

reviews.title: 3 Criticisms
reviews.text: On mobile the recent update i got today made it so when you open the sticker menu on lives they're much smaller and harder to see (mainly if they have text on but also just in general too). My other criticism is that over the last few months I've noticed MUCH more frequent ads to the point it's getting irritating, and that on top of the combination that tiktok also recently added a subscription to remove ads makes it feel intentional to drive users to buy the subscription with how frequent the ads are now. No user wants to be stuck between the decision of picking between a load of ads or buying a subscription, it just ends up driving some users away from wanting to continue using the app. On top of this the monthly super-fan subscription is also overpriced for what it offers, it shouldn't be nearly £10 a month just for flashy entry effects to lives, extra stickers, etc. Those features feel like bare minimum at best for what you're paying for it. Give user's more features for the current price or make it cheaper. Sorry if this comes off as blunt but I just want to be straightforward without the sugar coating as a user who had been using this app since 2020.
